about: Hand-written canonical JSON cases (RFC 8785 subset: no floats). Each input is JSON text so both languages parse it themselves. scripts/make_vectors.py checks the Python output against 'expected' and writes canonical_json.json with sha256 added.

cases.name: string escapes
cases.input: {"s": "quote\" back\\ nl\n tab\t bs\b ff\f cr\r ctl\u0001\u001f del\u007f e\u00e9 euro\u20ac"}
cases.expected: {"s":"quote\" back\\ nl\n tab\t bs\b ff\f cr\r ctl\u0001\u001f del eé euro€"}
